summary: A system that fuses drone and radar data to suggest targets to military operators of the armed forces, used only for defence.
headline: Article 2(3) excludes AI systems used exclusively for military, defence or national security purposes, so the Act does not apply as described.

steps.title: Scope
steps.question: Is this an AI system that falls under the Act?
steps.reasoning: The system is an AI system, but it is described as used only by the armed forces for targeting support. Article 2(3) takes AI systems used exclusively for military, defence or national security purposes out of the Act.

citations.label: Article 3(1)
citations.title: Definitions
citations.quote: ‘AI system’ means a machine-based system that is designed to operate with varying levels of autonomy

citations.label: Article 2(3)
citations.title: Scope
citations.quote: This Regulation does not apply to AI systems where and in so far they are placed on the market, put into service, or used with or without modification exclusively for military, defence or national security purposes
